description: This Go source file defines a package 'cvd' related to managing Android Virtual Devices (AVDs) using command-line tools such as 'cvd' and 'fetch_cvd'. It includes structures representing CVD instances and groups, credentials handling, and a CLI wrapper with methods for creating, managing, and fetching AVDs, as well as gathering fleet information.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group of CVD instances, with a name and a list of instances.

classes.name: Instance
classes.description: Represents a single CVD instance, including its name, status, displays, directory, WebRTC device ID, and ADB serial.

classes.name: Fleet
classes.description: Contains a list of groups representing the current CVD fleet state.

classes.name: FetchCredentials
classes.description: Interface for credentials used when fetching/loading CVD images, supporting adding authentication details to commands.

classes.name: FetchTokenFileCredentials
classes.description: Credentials implementation using an OAuth2 token file, with optional project ID.

classes.name: FetchGceCredentials
classes.description: Credentials implementation that uses GCE service account metadata.

classes.name: Selector
classes.description: Allows filtering of CVD instances or groups by name.

classes.name: CLI
classes.description: Wrapper for the 'cvd' command-line tool, providing methods to manage CVD instances and fleet.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a CVD configuration from a provided config path, optionally using credentials, and returns a Group.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates new CVD instances based on selector, creation options, and start options, returning a Group.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a CVD instance or group based on the selector and provided start options.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a CVD instance or group identified by the selector.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a CVD instance or group based on the selector.

methods.name: Fleet
methods.description: Retrieves the current CVD fleet status as a list of groups.

methods.name: BugReport
methods.description: Generates a bug report for a specific CVD instance or group, with option to include ADB bug report, outputting to specified destination.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a CVD instance or group.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended CVD instance or group.

methods.name: TakeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the specified CVD instance or group at the given directory path.

methods.name: PowerWash
methods.description: Performs a 'powerwash' (factory reset) on the specified CVD instance or group.

methods.name: PowerBtn
methods.description: Simulates a power button press on the specified CVD instance or group.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Fetches CVD images/builds based on provided fetch options and credentials, with target directory.
